codes.note: Dataset of sentences annotated for BDI-II depression symptom relevance by expert assessors; ChatGPT, GPT-4 and Vicuna evaluated as assessors against human annotations.
LLMs extract advance care planning information (code status, decision maker) from clinical notes. This is administrative clinical documentation, not a psychological construct.
Expert ratings of mental-health answers; follow-up compares LLM judges with human expert ratings on the same responses (safety, quality dimensions).
LLM judge rates chatbot suicide-risk responses with a rubric, validated against licensed clinician ratings (IRR 0.81 vs clinician consensus).
LLMs estimate PTSD severity from narratives against self-reports (criterion validity), but the abstract mentions human rater agreement as a comparison, so human ratings of the same texts may exist.
LLMs vs human on literary craft features in Turkish narrative scenes (metaphor, simile); not a psychological or clinical construct.
GPT-4 zero-shot coding of motives, norms, emotions and stances in online posts, evaluated against trained human coders' labels.
GPT-4o labels disinformation vs. trustworthy posts against manual labels. Disinformation is not a psychological or clinical construct under this review's criteria.
Claim matching for fact-checking misinformation; not a psychological or clinical construct.
LLM coder scores Rorschach Morbid Content responses; response-level kappa and protocol-level ICC reported against human assessors.
Role-playing agent benchmark with user simulators and rubrics for user satisfaction; no psychological construct coding of text against human labels.
Spine surgeons rate LLM-generated patient-education answers on osteoporotic fractures; not psychological text and no LLM coding or rating against human labels.
Physicians rate LLM answers about premature ovarian insufficiency; no LLM coding of psychological text and no psychological construct.
LLM recommends treatments for vignettes compared with expert rankings; this is decision support, not coding or rating of psychological text.
Commentary/letter on LLM symptom extraction from neuro-oncology clinical notes; non-psychological medical symptoms and no empirical study.
Specialists rated accuracy of ChatGPT answers on vasectomy questions; no LLM coding of psychological text against human labels.
LLM behavior-control method for generation (detoxification, truthfulness); no coding of psychological text against human coders.
This is a PREreview, a peer-review commentary on another paper. The underlying study (LLM judges vs expert safety ratings) would be screened as its own record.
GPT-5 scores CLASS teacher-child interactions from transcripts against human raters; design fits, but the construct is educational quality and only partly psychological (emotional support).
LLMs classify reasons for oncology treatment discontinuation from clinical notes against chart review; non-psychological clinical construct.
GPT-3 applies expert codebooks for deductive coding of curiosity-driven questions, with agreement against expert coders reported; curiosity is a psychological construct.
Randomized crossover trial of AI voice-to-text for medical affairs documentation; no LLM coding of psychological constructs against human labels.
LLMs (ICL and instruction fine-tuning) identify client motivational language in MI transcripts, evaluated against human MI codes.
LLM codes MI counseling sessions with MISC scheme, evaluated against expert annotations in a bilingual dataset.
ChatGPT codes facial photographs (emotions, FACS action units), not written or transcribed text, though it is compared with a human FACS specialist.
Urban mobility simulation with generative agents; no LLM coding of psychological text against human labels.
GPT-4/Llama-2 assess PTSD from clinician-administered interview transcripts; unclear whether reference labels are clinician ratings of the same text or diagnoses.
Dermatologists rate LLM chatbot answers on herpes zoster; no LLM rating, and the topic is medical, not psychological.
Humans annotate LLM and human-written role-play responses; no LLM rating compared with human labels, so it is a generation-evaluation dataset.
Microtubule image segmentation with vision foundation models; no psychological text or LLM coding against human labels.
Narrative review of AI in breast medicine (senology); not about LLM coding of psychological text.
Agentic LLM extracts immune-related adverse events from oncology clinical notes; non-psychological medical construct.
LLMs identify early maladaptive schemas in mental health QA posts; the abstract doesn't say whether reference labels come from human annotators, so full text is needed.
LLM extracts reporting and open-science practices from journal articles (metascience), not coding psychological constructs in psychological text.

Online discourse coded for entitativity, emotion, and valence. The abstract reports human validation only for the LLM relevance gate, so it is unclear whether the psychological coding was also compared with humans.
Zero-shot LLMs classify Reddit posts on C-SSRS severity levels and are compared with human annotations, so LLM–human agreement can be reported.
Orthopedic surgeons rate ChatGPT/Gemini answers on clavicle fractures; non-psychological, and humans rate LLM outputs with no LLM coding.
LLM classifies stance of medical-AI journal abstracts; not a psychological or clinical construct in patient or client text, though it was validated against human coding.
GPTs and trained research assistants coded goal essays for spirituality; human–GPT consistency reported, so agreement is available.
GPT-4 classified intellectual humility and perspective-taking in conflict narratives, compared with expert human coders (κ, F1).
Fine-tuned Llama-2-7B scores question complexity in a creative question-asking task and is compared with human ratings (r = .84).
LLMs coded patient narratives for thematic domains including psychological burden; clinicians coded a subset, but the construct is mostly disease burden and LLM–human agreement is unclear.
LLM and humans label emotions for Cantonese lexicon entries; unclear whether LLM–human agreement is reported, and the units are words, not clinical text.
ChatGPT coded forum posts on sugar-reduction behaviour change mechanisms; precision assessed against human coding and intercoder kappa reported.
Generic sentiment classification of IMDB movie reviews; not a psychological or clinical construct.
MLLM labels emotion in video/speech, with accuracy on MELD human labels and human validation. The emotion construct fits, but the input is multimodal rather than clearly text.
Biomedical literature information extraction challenge (NER/relations on PubMed abstracts); not psychological text coding, and no LLM-human coder agreement focus.
Essay/commentary on ChatGPT and human judgement; no empirical LLM coding of psychological text against human labels.
GPT-3.5/4 evaluated against human-annotated wellness dimension labels (MultiWD) and expert explanations (WellXplain) in mental health posts.
Humans rated quality (EQIP) of LLM-generated bipolar information; no LLM rating texts against human coders.
Multimodal speech emotion recognition model; LLM used for label smoothing/augmentation, not for coding agreement against human coders.
Tweet sentiment about ChatGPT using TextBlob, VADER and classical ML (SVM); generic sentiment, no LLM coding against human labels.
Med-PaLM 2 estimates depression/PTSD scores from interviews and compares with human clinical raters, but the reference may be standardized scores or diagnoses rather than human coding.
Surgeons rate LLM and Google answers on lumbar stenosis for accuracy and completeness. No LLM coding of psychological text, and the topic is not psychological.
Anesthesiologists rated ChatGPT and Gemini patient-education outputs; no LLM rating of text against human labels, and no psychological construct.
New annotated Chinese social media datasets (suicide risk, cognitive distortions) benchmark LLMs against human-annotated labels.
ChatGPT-4o/4.5 and human coders coded open-ended Add Health responses on ACEs and mentoring roles, compared in SPSS; agreement is likely reported.
Humans rate chatbot answers on HPV vaccination; no LLM codes psychological text and no psychological construct is involved.
Fine-tuned Bio_ClinicalBERT (encoder) identifying venous thromboembolism in oncology clinical notes; non-psychological medical construct and not a generative LLM.
LLM judge rates chatbot safety in suicide-risk conversations with a rubric; validated against licensed clinician ratings (IRR 0.81 vs 0.77).
LLMs rated 39 symptom items from Korean psycho-oncology interview transcripts, compared with psycho-oncologist ratings (ICC reported).
Rectal cancer treatment plans from LLMs rated by oncologists; non-psychological medical domain and humans rating LLM outputs.
LLM-as-Judge rates safety of responses in Chinese mental health crisis dialogues; agreement with expert assessments reported on 3600 judgments.
Surgical guideline adherence of LLM recommendations rated by surgeons; no psychological construct coded in text.
LLM identified psychotherapy dissatisfaction in forum posts; human raters validated outputs, which suggests an embedded LLM–human agreement check.
Correspondence commenting on a medical diagnosis study (NEJM cases); non-psychological and a commentary, not an empirical LLM coding study.
LLMs map emotional expressions to Reversal Theory families and a blind four-rater human coding study exists, but it's unclear whether LLM–human agreement is reported.
LLMs are the subjects of affect induction; humans rate LLM sentence-completion outputs, and no LLM codes or rates text against human labels.
Commentary on ChatGPT in scientific writing; no LLM coding of psychological text against human labels.
LLM codebook annotation of depression video keyframes compared with two human coders; modality is images rather than text, so eligibility is borderline.
LLMs classify financial asset sentiment and brand involvement in news, compared with human annotations, but there is no psychological or clinical construct.
LLM rates therapeutic alliance in text-based counseling transcripts, evaluated against expert annotations using a guideline framework.
Gemma 3 and trained raters both scored dream narratives for affect, but the abstract reports prediction of PTSD, not LLM–human agreement; the full text may report it.
GPT rates valence dynamics in narratives, compared with human affective ratings (correlation); emotion construct in text with human reference.
LLMs predict cybersecurity vulnerability triage (SSVC) decisions; no psychological or clinical text construct.
LLMs rate occupations on RIASEC and Big Five and are compared with O*NET expert ratings, but the rated material is occupation descriptions, not clearly psychological text.
Fake news emotion-stance analysis using deep learning classifiers and synthetic data; no LLM coding versus human coders agreement on psychological text.

Benchmark of MLLMs scoring psychotherapist interpersonal skills in response videos against expert annotations; agreement with human experts reported. Videos are multimodal, but transcripts are likely included.
LLM prompting detects mental manipulation in dialogues on MentalManip, which has human-annotated labels; accuracy is measured against those labels.
ChatGPT and Claude coded interpersonal emotion regulation strategies in narratives, with agreement against human coders reported as kappa.
Benchmark with human-annotated scenarios for LLM emotional/pragmatic inference; unclear whether the construct counts as psychological and whether LLM-human agreement is reported.
Marketing study where ChatGPT generates reviews and posts; humans rate the AI output, with no LLM coding or rating of psychological text.
GPT-4 Turbo identifies symptom sections and names in psychiatric interview transcripts, evaluated against expert-labeled data (accuracy, F1).
Hybrid LLM and human annotation of drug use and overdose symptoms in social media posts. Unclear whether LLM–human agreement is reported, or whether LLMs were only used to label training data.
Students' metaphors about GenAI were coded by human raters (kappa 0.92); no LLM performed the coding.
Physicians rate LLM responses on PET/CT questions; the content is medical, not psychological coding, and no LLM rates texts against human labels.
Zero-shot LLMs label emotions in conversations against benchmark labels, with human re-annotation and an LLM-as-Judge framework; emotion is a psychological construct.
An LLM architecture for emotional reasoning, trained without human annotations; it is not framed as LLM–human coder agreement on psychological text.
LLM-as-judge rates psychosocial safety (manipulation, psychological harm, insults) of responses, validated against human safety annotations in PKU-SafeRLHF.
Rule-based NLP extracting physical metabolic health outcomes from YouTube comments; LLM only assists interrater checks, and the construct is not psychological.

LLM classifies cognitive distortions on a public dataset; likely human-annotated labels, but the abstract doesn't say. It focuses on method improvement, so the human-label comparison needs full-text check.
Fine-tuned LLMs score AIHQ open-ended responses (hostility attributions, aggression), compared against trained human raters' ratings.
ALLM judges rate speaking style of synthetic speech from spoken language models against humans; audio, not psychological/clinical text, and no clinical construct.
Specialists and patients rate LLM patient-education answers for NMOSD; no LLM codes or rates texts against human labels, and the topic is not psychological.
ChatGPT-based DoT prompting detects cognitive distortions in patient speech, evaluated against human-annotated labels; experts also rated the rationales.
Qualitative literature review on AI and posthuman teaching in education; no LLM coding of psychological text against human coders.
LLM rates fidelity of lay-delivered therapy session transcripts on 6 domains; interrater reliability (ICC, AC2) against human supervisor ratings.
LLaMA3 deductively coded suicide-bereavement interview data; Cohen's kappa agreement with researchers' coding reported.
A peer review of a statistics methods paper on ANOVA, SDT and GLMMs for binary judgments. It involves no LLM and no coding of text.
Crisis counseling outcome prediction using human-annotated and LLM-generated features; unclear whether LLM labels are compared with human annotations on the same texts.
LLM vs clinician consensus agreement (kappa) on classifying EHR mental health terms; units are extracted terms, not narrative text, so the construct fit is borderline.
Benchmark of patient queries dual-annotated by humans and GPT-4o for empathy applicability, with human–GPT alignment reported.
Human raters evaluate chatbot responses on TBI information; no LLM rates or codes texts against human labels.
